core_principles: No fluff: 100% functional data density. Every pixel must serve a diagnostic purpose.
High contrast over soft aesthetics: Sharp borders, stark whites, signal reds.
Terminal/Control Room Vibe: Data is the hero, UI is the rigid container.

fonts.install_command: Ensure you load Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, and IBM Plex Mono from Google Fonts in index.html.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Mode B: The Control Room Grid. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 or 12-col dense layouts. gap-4 or gap-6 maximum.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-sm (2px to 4px). Prohibited: rounded-2xl, rounded-3xl or full pill shapes.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Strict left-alignment for all data. Center alignment only for empty states or specialized visualizations.

components.surfaces: bg-[#13151A] border border-[#2D333B] rounded-sm shadow-none. No glassmorphism unless it is a floating modal.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0047FF] text-white hover:bg-[#003BD6] rounded-sm transition-colors text-sm font-medium px-4 py-2
buttons.danger: bg-[#E63946] text-white hover:bg-[#D92D39] rounded-sm transition-colors text-sm font-medium px-4 py-2
buttons.outline: border border-[#2D333B] text-[#E1E7EF] hover:bg-[#1C1F26] rounded-sm transition-colors text-sm font-medium px-4 py-2

components.tables: High density. text-sm. Thead uses Overline typography styling with uppercase and wide tracking. Tbody must use IBM Plex Mono for IPs, Phone numbers, IMEIs, and Timestamps.
components.badges: Square or very slightly rounded (rounded-sm). High contrast background opacity (e.g. bg-[#E63946]/20) with solid text (text-[#E63946]) and matching border (border border-[#E63946]/30).
components.inputs_and_forms: bg-[#090A0C] border-[#2D333B] focus:border-[#0047FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0047FF] text-[#E1E7EF] rounded-sm.
components.charts: Use Recharts with transparent backgrounds, stark grid lines (stroke-[#2D333B] or stroke-white/5), and solid accent colors for data lines/bars without gradients.

motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out for hovers and active states.

icons.style: Duotone or Regular. Strict technical appearance.

recommended_libraries.name: recharts
recommended_libraries.use_for: Line charts for Temporal Overlap, Bar charts for Behavioral Profiling, Scatter for correlations.

recommended_libraries.name: react-force-graph-2d
recommended_libraries.use_for: Interactive Network/Relationship Graph Visualization for Contact Networks (yarn add react-force-graph-2d).

recommended_libraries.name: lucide-react
recommended_libraries.use_for: Fallback UI Icons if Phosphor is unavailable.

auth_background.description: Dark abstract textile grain, use for login/auth background or empty states. Overlay heavily with bg-[#090A0C]/80.

agency_logo.description: Abstract agency/police patch for top left navbar or sidebar header to add official forensic context. Mask as a circle or subtle square.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Write all code using JavaScript (.js or .jsx). Do not use TypeScript (.ts or .tsx).
This is a forensic intelligence analysis dashboard. It MUST NOT look like a playful or generic SaaS. Prioritize grid density and technical accuracy.
Strictly follow the color palette. Backgrounds are #090A0C, cards are #13151A. Borders are #2D333B.
Use Chivo for headings and IBM Plex Mono for ALL data points (IPs, numbers, metrics, dates, risk scores).
For the Network Graph, attempt to use react-force-graph-2d. If that fails or is too complex, mock a dense node network with D3 or custom SVG.
Use the Control Room Grid. Widgets must span logically and stretch vertically to fill their rows without jagged bottoms.
Add `data-testid` attributes to ALL interactive and informational elements (buttons, inputs, sidebar links, graph nodes, tables, risk scores). Use kebab-case.
